lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection worked, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, path duration hints, and photo processing hints won, while many other hints had no clear effect or hurt.
Personality-driven headlines, headline refreshes, and live countdown timers won, whereas general story copy, time headlines, and photo quality guidance hurt or showed no clear effect.
Specific layout redesigns and tutorial screens (such as photo upload split layout and tray guide screen) won, while sub-flows, trait selectors, and most flow bypasses hurt or showed no clear effect.
Notifications, audio chimes, wait-screen activity tips, badges, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains for targeted headlines, live timers, specific guide screens, and photo hints.
